        self,

            data,

@final
    def apply_groupwise(
        self, f: Callable, data: DataFrame | Series, axis: AxisInt = 0
    ) -> tuple[list, bool]:
        mutated = False
        splitter = self._get_splitter(data, axis=axis)
        group_keys = self.group_keys_seq
        result_values = []

        # This calls DataSplitter.__iter__
        zipped = zip(group_keys, splitter)

        for key, group in zipped:
            # Pinning name is needed for
            #  test_group_apply_once_per_group,
            #  test_inconsistent_return_type, test_set_group_name,
            #  test_group_name_available_in_inference_pass,
            #  test_groupby_multi_timezone
            object.__setattr__(group, "name", key)

            # group might be modified
            group_axes = group.axes
            res = f(group)
            if not mutated and not _is_indexed_like(res, group_axes, axis):
                mutated = True
            result_values.append(res)
        # getattr pattern for __name__ is needed for functools.partial objects
        if len(group_keys) == 0 and getattr(f, "__name__", None) in [
            "skew",
            "sum",
            "prod",
        ]:
            #  If group_keys is empty, then no function calls have been made,
            #  so we will not have raised even if this is an invalid dtype.
            #  So do one dummy call here to raise appropriate TypeError.
            f(data.iloc[:0])

        return result_values, mutated

from __future__ import annotations

import numbers

import pandas as pd
from pandas.core.window.rolling import Rolling

from .generic import patch_method


def _rolling_apply_chunk(payload: dict):
    obj = payload["obj"]
    result = obj.rolling(
        window=payload["window"],
        min_periods=payload["min_periods"],
        center=payload["center"],
        win_type=payload["win_type"],
        on=payload["on"],
        closed=payload["closed"],
        step=payload["step"],
        method=payload["method"],
    ).apply(
        payload["func"],
        raw=payload["raw"],
        engine=payload["engine"],
        engine_kwargs=payload["engine_kwargs"],
        args=payload["args"],
        kwargs=payload["kwargs"],
    )
    return result.iloc[payload["trim_start"] : payload["trim_stop"]]


def _supports_parallel_rolling(rolling_obj, engine) -> bool:
    if engine not in (None, "cython"):
        return False
    if not isinstance(rolling_obj.window, numbers.Integral):
        return False
    if rolling_obj.window <= 0:
        return False
    if rolling_obj.center:
        return False
    if rolling_obj.closed not in (None, "right"):
        return False
    if rolling_obj.step is not None:
        return False
    if rolling_obj.on is not None:
        return False
    if rolling_obj.win_type is not None:
        return False
    if getattr(rolling_obj, "_win_freq_i8", None) is not None:
        return False
    if rolling_obj.axis != 0:
        return False
    return True


def parallel_apply(
    self,
    func,
    raw: bool = False,
    engine=None,
    engine_kwargs=None,
    args=None,
    kwargs=None,
):
    from pandarallel.core import get_runtime_config, run_parallel_tasks
    from pandarallel.utils import chunk_slices

    args = () if args is None else tuple(args)
    kwargs = {} if kwargs is None else dict(kwargs)

    if not _supports_parallel_rolling(self, engine):
        return self.apply(
            func,
            raw=raw,
            engine=engine,
            engine_kwargs=engine_kwargs,
            args=args,
            kwargs=kwargs,
        )

    task_slices = chunk_slices(len(self.obj), get_runtime_config().nb_workers)
    if len(task_slices) <= 1:
        return self.apply(
            func,
            raw=raw,
            engine=engine,
            engine_kwargs=engine_kwargs,
            args=args,
            kwargs=kwargs,
        )

    overlap = int(self.window) - 1
    payloads = []
    for task_slice in task_slices:
        start = task_slice.start or 0
        stop = task_slice.stop or 0
        extended_start = max(0, start - overlap)
        payloads.append(
            {
                "obj": self.obj.iloc[extended_start:stop],
                "window": self.window,
                "min_periods": self.min_periods,
                "center": self.center,
                "win_type": self.win_type,
                "on": self.on,
                "closed": self.closed,
                "step": self.step,
                "method": self.method,
                "func": func,
                "raw": raw,
                "engine": engine,
                "engine_kwargs": engine_kwargs,
                "args": args,
                "kwargs": kwargs,
                "trim_start": start - extended_start,
                "trim_stop": stop - extended_start,
            }
        )

    results = run_parallel_tasks(_rolling_apply_chunk, payloads, description="Rolling.apply")
    combined = pd.concat(results, axis=0)
    if isinstance(combined, pd.Series):
        combined = combined.reindex(self.obj.index)
        if isinstance(self.obj, pd.Series):
            combined.name = self.obj.name
        return combined
    return combined.reindex(index=self.obj.index)


def install() -> None:
    patch_method(Rolling, "parallel_apply", parallel_apply)
